title: Muggo Clicker
description:
Introducing Muggo Clicker, the idle clicker game that's easy to pick up and hard to put down! Meet Muggo, the adorable alien who loves being clicked. With each click, watch your counter increment by one, giving you that satisfying sense of progress. Think one click isn't enough? Click again!

There's more to it than counting, though – every click has a chance to score a drop. Each drop can be equipped to show off your achievements. Collect these unique items and every click starts to feel like a small win.

When you're ready to put your collection to use, step into Adventure Mode – a whole new way to play! Equip your melee weapon, shield, and vehicle to gain a real edge in battle, then add your own style with cosmetic helmets and world items. Venture beyond the clicker, gather ingredients and rewards along the way, and see what the right loadout can do.

Whether you're a casual player looking to pass the time, a collector chasing every drop, or an adventurer after the next challenge, Muggo Clicker has something for you. Click, collect, and explore – it's a simple idea that's surprisingly fun to come back to.

Discover different rarities, each crafted to keep your collection growing!
description_short: Introducing Muggo Clicker, the idle clicker that's easy to pick up and hard to put down! Muggo is an adorable alien who loves clicks. Every click raises your counter and offers a chance at epic drops. Equip your finds, then take your gear into Adventure Mode for a whole new way to play. Start now!
